pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Kosambiyaṃ viharati Ghositārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Channo anācāraṃ ācaritvā saṃghamajjhe āpattiyā anuyuñjiyamāno aññen' aññaṃ paṭicarati:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:1.3: ko āpanno kiṃ āpanno kismiṃ āpanno kathaṃ āpanno kaṃ bhaṇatha kiṃ bhaṇathā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:1.4: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te . . . vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:1.5: kathañ hi nāma āyasmā Channo saṃghamajjhe āpattiyā anuyuñjiyamāno aññen' aññaṃ paṭicarissati:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:1.7: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ Channa saṃghamajjhe āpattiyā anuyuñjiyamāno aññen' aññaṃ paṭicarasi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:1.11: kathañ hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa saṃghamajjhe . . .
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:1.13: n' etaṃ moghapurisa appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:1.16: tena hi bhikkhave saṃgho Channassa bhikkhuno aññavādakaṃ ropetu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:1.20: ayaṃ Channo bhikkhu saṃghamajjhe āpattiyā anuyuñjiyamāno aññen' aññaṃ paṭicarati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:1.21: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, saṃgho Channassa bhikkhuno aññavādakaṃ ropeyya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:1.26: yassāyasmato khamati Channassa bhikkhuno aññavādakassa ropanā so tuṇh' assa,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:1.30: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Channaṃ anekapariyāyena vigarahitvā dubbharatāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:1.31: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:1.33: evañ c' idaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:2.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Channo saṃghamajjhe āpattiyā anuyuñjiyamāno aññen' aññaṃ paṭicaranto
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:2.3: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te . . . vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:2.4: kathañ hi nāma āyasmā Channo saṃghamajjhe āpattiyā anuyuñjiyamāno tuṇhibhūto saṃghaṃ vihesessatīti --pa--.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:2.5: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ Channa saṃghamajjhe āpattiyā anuyuñjiyamāno tuṇhibhūto saṃghaṃ vihesesīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:2.8: kathañ hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa saṃghamajjhe . . . vihesessasi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:2.9: n' etaṃ moghapurisa appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:2.12: tena hi bhikkhave saṃgho Channassa bhikkhuno vihesakaṃ ropetu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:3.1.2: saṃghamajjhe vatthusmiṃ vā āpattiyā vā anuyuñjiyamāno taṃ na kathetukāmo taṃ na ugghāṭetukāmo aññen' aññaṃ paṭicarati: ko āpanno kiṃ āpanno kismiṃ āpanno kathaṃ āpanno kaṃ bhaṇatha kiṃ bhaṇathā 'ti, eso aññavādako nāma.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:3.1.4: saṃghamajjhe vatthusmiṃ vā āpattiyā vā anuyuñjiyamāno taṃ na kathetukāmo taṃ na ugghāṭetukāmo tuṇhibhūto saṃghaṃ viheseti, eso vihesako nāma.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:3.1.5.1: aropite aññavādake saṃghamajjhe vatthusmiṃ vā āpattiyā vā anuyuñjiyamāno taṃ na kathetukāmo taṃ na ugghāṭetukāmo aññen' aññaṃ paṭicarati:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:3.1.7: aropite vihesake saṃghamajjhe vatthusmiṃ . . . na ugghāṭetukāmo tuṇhibhūto saṃghaṃ viheseti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:3.2.1: dhammakamme dhammakammasaññī aññavādake vihesake āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:3.2.2: dhammakamme vematiko aññ. vih. āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:3.2.3: dhammakamme adhammakammasaññī aññ. vih. āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:3.3.4: saṃghassa bhaṇḍanaṃ vā kalaho vā viggaho vā vivādo vā bhavissatīti na katheti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:3.3.5: saṃghabhedo vā saṃgharāji vā bhavissatīti na katheti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:3.3.6: adhammena vā vaggena vā na kammārahassa vā kammaṃ karissatīti na katheti,
